stem.text: A stone S and a foam rubber ball R are identical spheres of equal volume. They are released from rest at time $t = 0$ and fall vertically through the air. Both reach terminal velocity.
Which graph best shows the variation with time $t$ of the speed $v$ of the stone and of the rubber ball?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing two curves labelled R and S.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing two curves labelled S and R.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing one curve labelled R and S.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing two curves labelled S and R.
